name: CAPOLAVORO
source:
Your life has become his masterpiece. With every stroke, his mind frays – and your world tightens. Will you stay by his side, or run from the madness?

[From [url=https://tokipetal.itch.io/capolavoro]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的生活已经成为他的杰作。每一次击打，他的思绪都会变得脆弱——而你的世界也会变得更加紧绷。你会留在他身边，还是逃离疯狂？

[来自[url=https://tokipetal.itch.io/capolavoro]Itch.io[/url]]
